summary: The patient missed their appointment because they did not receive a reminder notification and subsequently forgot about the scheduled visit.
recommended_action: Implement an automated SMS or email reminder system sent 24-48 hours prior to all appointments.

summary: The patient missed their appointment due to the clinic's distance and a lack of available transportation on the day of the visit.
recommended_action: Offer telehealth consultations for routine check-ups to patients living in remote areas.

summary: The patient missed their appointment due to the high cost of the consultation fee and inquired about potential discounts.
recommended_action: Implement a sliding scale fee structure or offer loyalty discounts for recurring follow-up appointments.

summary: The patient missed their appointment due to a high fever and body aches, intending to reschedule once they have recovered.
recommended_action: Send a follow-up message to the patient once a reasonable recovery period has passed to assist with rescheduling.

summary: The patient missed their appointment due to an urgent, mandatory work meeting and requested an evening time slot for future visits.
recommended_action: Offer extended clinic hours or evening appointment slots to accommodate patients with rigid work schedules.

summary: The patient missed the appointment because they forgot and did not receive an SMS reminder. They wish to reschedule.
recommended_action: Implement an automated SMS reminder system sent 24 hours before scheduled appointments.

summary: The patient missed the appointment due to a city bus strike and lack of available transportation options near their residence.
recommended_action: Offer telehealth consultations for patients residing in areas with limited public transportation access.

summary: The clinic attempted to contact the patient three times, but the phone was switched off, preventing confirmation of the appointment.
recommended_action: Implement an automated SMS reminder system to supplement phone calls.

summary: The patient missed the appointment due to a mandatory shift change at their workplace and requested Saturday availability.
recommended_action: Offer the patient Saturday appointment slots to accommodate their work schedule.
